@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+package config
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v5"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaults(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), cfg.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, cfg.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestLoadTracingOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestTracingSamplingRatioValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		err := cfg.validate()
+		require.EqualError(t, err, "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTracingPropagatorValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, "unknown"}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{
+		TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage,
+		TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorB3Multi,
+		TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+		TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+}
+
+func TestTracingSchemaAcceptsOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	schema, err := jsonschema.Compile("../../config/flipt.schema.json")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, schema.Validate(map[string]any{
+		"tracing": map[string]any{
+			"samplingRatio": 0.5,
+			"propagators":   []any{"tracecontext", "baggage", "b3", "b3multi", "jaeger", "xray", "ottrace", "none"},
+		},
+	}))
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
+)
+
+func TestProviderUsesConfiguredSamplingRatio(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		ratio         float64
+		wantRecording bool
+	}{
+		{ratio: 0, wantRecording: false},
+		{ratio: 1, wantRecording: true},
+	} {
+		provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "test", tt.ratio)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "span")
+		require.Equal(t, tt.wantRecording, span.IsRecording())
+		span.End()
+		require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	}
+}
+
+func TestConfiguredPropagators(t *testing.T) {
+	p, err := NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorB3})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Contains(t, p.Fields(), "x-b3-traceid")
+
+	p, err = NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorNone})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, p.Fields())
+
+	p, err = NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, config.TracingPropagatorBaggage})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}).Fields(), p.Fields())
+}

+package config
+
+import (
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/santhosh-tekuri/jsonschema/v5"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestTracingDefaults(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	require.Equal(t, float64(1), cfg.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage}, cfg.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestLoadTracingOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "config.yml")
+	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte("tracing:\n  samplingRatio: 0.5\n  propagators: [b3, jaeger]\n"), 0600))
+	result, err := Load(path)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, 0.5, result.Config.Tracing.SamplingRatio)
+	require.Equal(t, []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorJaeger}, result.Config.Tracing.Propagators)
+}
+
+func TestTracingSamplingRatioValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{-0.1, 1.1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		err := cfg.validate()
+		require.EqualError(t, err, "sampling ratio should be a number between 0 and 1")
+	}
+	for _, ratio := range []float64{0, 0.5, 1} {
+		cfg := Default().Tracing
+		cfg.SamplingRatio = ratio
+		require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+	}
+}
+
+func TestTracingPropagatorValidation(t *testing.T) {
+	cfg := Default().Tracing
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, "unknown"}
+	require.EqualError(t, cfg.validate(), "invalid propagator option: unknown")
+
+	cfg.Propagators = []TracingPropagator{
+		TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage,
+		TracingPropagatorB3, TracingPropagatorB3Multi,
+		TracingPropagatorJaeger, TracingPropagatorXRay,
+		TracingPropagatorOTTrace, TracingPropagatorNone,
+	}
+	require.NoError(t, cfg.validate())
+}
+
+func TestTracingSchemaAcceptsOptions(t *testing.T) {
+	schema, err := jsonschema.Compile("../../config/flipt.schema.json")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, schema.Validate(map[string]any{
+		"tracing": map[string]any{
+			"samplingRatio": 0.5,
+			"propagators":   []any{"tracecontext", "baggage", "b3", "b3multi", "jaeger", "xray", "ottrace", "none"},
+		},
+	}))
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+package tracing
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config"
+	"go.opentelemetry.io/otel/propagation"
+)
+
+func TestProviderUsesConfiguredSamplingRatio(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		ratio         float64
+		wantRecording bool
+	}{
+		{ratio: 0, wantRecording: false},
+		{ratio: 1, wantRecording: true},
+	} {
+		provider, err := NewProvider(context.Background(), "test", tt.ratio)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		_, span := provider.Tracer("test").Start(context.Background(), "span")
+		require.Equal(t, tt.wantRecording, span.IsRecording())
+		span.End()
+		require.NoError(t, provider.Shutdown(context.Background()))
+	}
+}
+
+func TestConfiguredPropagators(t *testing.T) {
+	p, err := NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorB3})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Contains(t, p.Fields(), "x-b3-traceid")
+
+	p, err = NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorNone})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Empty(t, p.Fields())
+
+	p, err = NewPropagator([]config.TracingPropagator{config.TracingPropagatorTraceContext, config.TracingPropagatorBaggage})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, propagation.NewCompositeTextMapPropagator(propagation.TraceContext{}, propagation.Baggage{}).Fields(), p.Fields())
+}
